name: Ancient Theatrical Stage
description: There is a stage in Datang Street, which is very lively every day. Wonderful songs are performed in turn, and the audience cheers! This theater is gorgeous and brilliant, and its triple eaves structure is particularly majestic. Pom-pom helmets and flags are decorated on the top, which is majestic. The eaves and drums are decorated with facial makeup elements, which is full of theatrical charm. The show is about to begin, Pinku invites you to listen to a long and lasting song of Drunken Concubine!
